blocks.text: SINGAPORE — President Marcos has been invited to the Formula One Singapore Grand Prix, but Malacañang on Wednesday stopped short of confirming whether he would attend the race during his five-day working visit here. Palace press officer Claire Castro confirmed that an invitation had been extended to Marcos but said the President himself should announce whether he would attend the event. “Nandiyan iyong invitation, totoo naman po iyan. At hindi naman ito ikinakaila at hindi ito itinatago,” Castro told reporters in Singapore. (The invitation is there; that is true. It is not being denied or hidden.) “But if the President will […]...
